explanation: This test only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock), nor does it verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test misses assertions about the order of operations and the locking of FX rate, and it does not test the approval workflow for large top-ups.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at the moment top-up is initiated
Verify destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited
Verify that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: A bug where the funding source is debited before the destination wallet is credited would not be caught, nor would a bug where the FX rate changes after initiation but before settlement. Also, a bug where top-ups above SGD 10,000 do not require second-owner approval would be missed.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up process including FX rate lock, credit before debit, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate is locked and does not change during transaction
Verify destination wallet balance increases by SGD 500 before funding source is debited
Verify funding source is debited after wallet credit
Verify that second business owner approval is requested before settlement
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 15,000 after approval
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet credit and approval
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; wallet balance increases accordingly
